_comment: The Forbidden/Limited list (by card name, as in BabelCDB). forbidden/limited/semiLimited are the TCG May 2008 list as published (Yugipedia "May 2008 Lists", in effect 2008-05-09 to 2008-08-31). "changes" moves cards to another status for this game ("unlimited" takes a card off the list), e.g. because the pool plays a card's modern, errata'd version; each says why. Built into public/data/cards.json (`limit`) by tools/data/build-data.mjs.
name: TCG May 2008
forbidden: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End

Right Arm of the Forbidden One

Witch of the Black Forest.why: Modern version: once per turn, and the searched card's name can't be used that turn.

Ring of Destruction.why: Modern version: only on the opponent's turn, only a monster whose ATK is at most their LP, 1 per turn.

Sinister Serpent.why: Modern version: once per turn, and a Sinister Serpent in the GY is banished in the opponent's next End Phase.

Makyura the Destructor.why: Modern version: once per turn, and only 1 Trap from the hand.

Exchange of the Spirit.why: Modern version: both players need 15+ cards in the GY, and only 1 per Duel.
